business_problem: Volkswagen Group Services needed to replace lengthy, manual HR reporting cycles with a centralized data foundation that managers could query directly for reliable workforce insights.
solution_summary: Volkswagen Group Services modernized HR analytics with IBM Planning Analytics to centralize workforce data and automate reporting. Before the project, the HR team lacked a unified system for data management, making reporting resource-intensive, slow and inconsistent. IBM Planning Analytics became the shared planning and analytics layer, establishing a consistent data foundation for roughly 10,000 employees and enabling role-controlled access for hundreds of managers. Automated calculations now run in about one second, and managers can generate reports on demand instead of waiting days for HR specialists to prepare them. Because all users work from the same governed dataset, the solution improves transparency and reduces reconciliation effort while also creating a scalable platform that the company can extend beyond HR into operations and future analytics use cases.
